Unnamed: 1: This excel file lists the variables with their flags and codes that are in the Interview and Diary survey. Information on variables and flags are in the "Variables" tab and information on codes in the "Codes" tab.
Variables tab
Survey lists the survey the CE used to collect the data for a given variable.
File lists the file in which a variable appears.
Variable Name lists the variable name, for example AMTFED.
Variable Description describes the variable.
Formula lists the formula used to calculate or condition used to derive a given variable (if applicable).
Flag Variable lists the associated flag variable name. For example AMTFED_ is the associated flag variable for AMTFED.
Section Number lists the section in the survey. For information on the survey forms, see the link below.
Section Description describes the section in the survey forms. For more information on the survey forms, see the link below.
Section Part lists the part in the section of the survey form. For more information on the survey forms, see the link below.
First Year lists the first year in which a variable appeared in that specific data file.
First Quarter lists the first quarter in which a variable appeared in that specific data file.
Last Year lists the last year in which a variable appeared in that specific data file.
Last Quarter lists the last quarter in which a variable appeared in that specific data file.
Comment lists any unique processing changes.
Codes tab
Survey lists the survey that the CE used to collect the data for this variable.
File lists the file in which the code appears.
Variable Name lists the variable name, for example AMTFED.
Code Value lists the possible code values, for example 1 or 2.
Code Description describes the code.
First Year lists the first year in which a variable appeared in that specific data file.
First Quarter lists the first quarter in which a variable appeared in that specific data file.
Last Year lists the last year in which a variable appeared in that specific data file.
Last Quarter lists the last quarter in which a variable appeared in that specific data file.
Missing values are indicated by blank cells.
